target.statement: CoHD with Swin-Tiny backbone achieves 65.89 gIoU on the gRefCOCO validation set (Table 1, row 'CoHD (Ours)' with Swin-T).

compute.basis: Training CoHD with Swin-T on gRefCOCO requires ~1 day on 8x A10 GPUs (paper states 13-18GB per GPU); on a single 8-core CPU laptop this is infeasible within a few hours, and even with a mid-range GPU it would take many hours.

blockers: Requires GPU training (8x A10 in paper, ~1 day)
No pre-trained model weights provided for direct evaluation
title: CoHD: A Counting-Aware Hierarchical Decoding Framework for Generalized Referring Expression Segmentation
